availability: Production server is not configured. Offline racing is available.
release_notes: Controls: new default SLIDE STEERING BOX. Touch the invisible square around the left wheel without turning; slide left/right to steer, hold the angle and lift to straighten.
Steering fix: reversing your finger changes steering direction without returning through the original touchdown. Long overshoots no longer trap the previous direction.
Steering fix: unused right-side touches cannot take steering ownership. Small deliberate drags survive filtering, and a neutral steering finger overrides conflicting external input.
Controls: independent pedals and drift, mouse drag with lost-release recovery, safe-area and placement cleanup, and one-time migration preserving saved settings.

Validation: square/corner/multitouch/cancellation checks, actual chassis direction tests, native Windows driving and isolated authoritative multiplayer checks. Existing fence mapping and camera visibility regressions remain enabled.
Preview limitation: physical Android controls, Low/Medium/High graphics, FPS, lifecycle and phone/Windows cross-play remain unverified. Public multiplayer hosting remains unconfigured.
limitations: Physical Android installation testing remains incomplete.

Final Android Low/Medium/High rendering, touch, lifecycle and phone/Windows cross-play remain unverified.
